thread:
oncall_tony: Hey team — I opened a hotfix PR to address the 95th latency spike we saw at ~13:20 PST. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5423. CI currently ✅. Needs 2 approvals to merge. Can someone take a quick look?

alex_m: quick question — is this a behavioral change or revert of the new backoff?

oncall_tony: It's a small behavioral change: we reduced the aggressive client retry window introduced in the router patch. TL;DR: retries were stacking and spiking p95 under certain burst patterns. Patch reduces retry window and adds a short jitter. Diff snippet: `-retryWindow = 300ms
+retryWindow = 100ms // reduce retry stacking` Should be low-risk.

deploy-bot: CI checks: unit-tests ✅ integration-tests ✅ e2e-canary: pending (requires manual canary trigger)

jia: Can we run a 10m canary in prod-east first? I'll watch traces. If we see regressions roll back.

matt: I can do the canary verification at 14:05 PST. Ping me when it's merged and canary started.

sre_roberta: I can review now, give me ~20m. Please add the rollout/undo commands in the PR description (for oncall).

oncall_tony: added rollback snippet to PR description: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/request-router && kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/request-router` Also added a dashboard link to the latency chart.

alex_m: quick scan looks good. small nit about comment formatting, not blocking.

sre_roberta: Reviewed the logic and unit tests. Approving now. :thumbsup:

alex_m: Approving as well — no functional concerns from my side.

deploy-bot: Merge check: required_approvals=2 satisfied. Merging on request.

oncall_tony: Merged and started canary (prod-east, 10% traffic). Monitoring N+1 for 15m. Thanks all.

matt: Watching now — let me know if you want me to promote to 100% after 15m.

oncall_tony: Will wait 15m and re-evaluate. If canary looks stable I'll push full rollout and post status here.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete: 10% -> OK. No errors at 95th reported in the first 12m.

oncall_tony: Canary looks clean at 15m, promoting to 100% now. `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/request-router` triggered.

matt: Observability checks green from my side. p95 back down to ~320ms. Nice.

oncall_tony: Excellent — closing the loop. If anyone sees anomalies please ping oncall. Thanks for the quick reviews. :heart:
